summary: Frontend-only validation of WallStory portfolio site. Verified preloader completes, hero renders 'Complete Interior Solution', all 7 sections appear in the expected vertical order (hero -> marquee -> services -> projects -> about -> philosophy -> contact), the 'What We Do' section has exactly 3 service rows (residential, commercial, modular), hover state turns title gold and swaps the cursor-following preview cleanly, all 5 nav links smooth-scroll to their sections, and the contact form demo shows the success state after valid submission. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Services.jsx: the floating cursor-follow preview uses position: fixed with framer-motion x/y motion values on the container plus absolutely-positioned children. This works but a small perf note — all 3 images stay mounted (intentional for zero-lag), consider using loading='eager' + fetchpriority='high' on the first image only to avoid layout jank on first hover.
Preloader hard-codes duration 1900ms; consider skipping/shortening for repeat visitors via sessionStorage to improve perceived performance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested acceptance criteria pass. Verified: 7 data-testid sections present in correct order (tops monotonically increasing), 3 service items with gold hover + description reveal, cursor-follow floating image swaps smoothly between rows, nav-link-* smooth-scrolls work for services/projects/about/philosophy/contact, contact-form submit with valid name+email shows contact-success. No console errors/warnings of concern (only one benign framer-motion 'non-static position' warning).
